response: Kurla (Ward L) billed Rs 13043418 for monsoon road repairs against a budget of Rs 11900000, or 109.6 percent of budget, across 232 jobs. Of these, 17.7 percent were reopened within 30 days and 31.9 percent met their service deadline. Rs 3959357 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs should cost the city nothing. 8 jobs were billed more than 30 percent above the rate card. These figures need review, with context: Kurla is a low lying ward (index 0.85) where flooding is common, and the city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain this season. The top contractor by spend was Sahyadri Infra Works (synthetic). A citizen or ward officer can ask for the invoices and warranty status for work orders WO25-00020 and WO25-00334.
